text: 株式会社シュゼット・ホールディングス (Suzette Holdings Co., Ltd.) is a Nishinomiya, Hyogo confectionery holding company whose brands include Henri Charpentier, C3 and Casaneo; its company profile names 蟻田剛毅 (Tsuyoshi Arita) as president and lists its group companies.
short: Suzette Holdings is a private Nishinomiya confectionery holding company, president Tsuyoshi Arita.
